fix.adapter: exclusive lock (msvcrt on Windows, fcntl elsewhere) held across seq allocation, execution and logging; serialisation is now enforced rather than assumed

fix.verifier: verb+args-digest join is a counted multiset and the shared stdout digest is matched within each call's fingerprint pool, both order-independent; added seq uniqueness and contiguity checks; a NOTE reports lock contention

byte_stability_verified: frozen baseline hook, amendment v2/v3, three frozen v1 packets and both signed candidates all zero diff
